core_fix.finding: Under -count=3 the real-window test failed at NewAtlas (status -2, slot limit 8). Bisection with a free-slot probe: every App that decoded an image kept its lazily created image codec (one native atlas slot) for the life of the process; gpui's own tests worked around it with a test-only releaseAppImageCodec. Five base tests (avatar image, inline virtual, table metrics, TextView block kinds, data-URL image) each leaked one slot.
